headline: TOR @ NYY matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TOR 4.14 at NYY 4.73, with a projected total of 8.87. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (TOR +0.26, NYY +0.17), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +0.43, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Patrick Corbin has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Daulton Varsho, Aaron Judge, Jazz Chisholm Jr., based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ryan McMahon, Austin Wells because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
